Name: English Country Garden - Herbal Teas
Author: runswithpencils
Description:
The seeds and recipes for tea can be purchased from Pierre, the recipes will be available to buy once you have reached high enough relationship points with Caroline.
Once you have a full ten hearts she will send you the tea set in the post.
I am also adding various classic English Recipes which can be purchased from Gus once a two heart relationship has been achieved.
I've only added Fish and Chips so far, but more to come soon.
I also plan to add more English Country Garden crops/flowers, recipes and more as time allows.
I will update my pixel art sprites once I improve (I appreciate they are more than a little rough).
Constructive criticism welcome, this is my first attempt at modding so please be gentle with me :)

Downloads.Description: Updated for 1.6, please let me know if you have any issues.
